instructions.meaning: Address the node incident-beam vector at offset 0x60
Dereference the first beam pointer; crash register rax is zero
Read the beam island index at offset 0x118

rules: Beam islands traverse beams sharing endpoint node IDs, registered plates and registered components.
Plate islands traverse actual boundary-beam references and registered components; missing boundaries are skipped.
Component islands traverse registered beams, plates and components.
Node island ownership is read from its first incident beam.
Signal links and physical mate constraints do not directly weld rigid islands.
Boundary lookup matches an unordered exact pair of node IDs.
limitations: Function fingerprints and machine instructions establish static evidence for this GCL version only.
Component contact registration and runtime dirty/rebuild/split scheduling are not fully reproduced.
Synthetic fixtures and local sample round-trips do not establish game loading compatibility.
